verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no published TFLOPS or TOPS figures for the RTX PRO 6000, with or without precision or sparsity qualifiers. The FP8 Transformer Engine mention describes supported precision, not throughput. A community comment refers only loosely to 'similar total AI TOPS' versus a B300, with no numbers. Throughput specs are a fair axis for a GPU, so absence of evidence yields none.
